ToD_A04_M13_VO_001.source_old: What is wrong? You seem to be on edge...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_001.source_new: What is wrong? You seem to be on edge...

ToD_A04_M13_VO_002.source_old: I have faced many great enemies throughout my life, Zuluhed. Ogres, Arakkoa, and once even a Genesaur... none gave me pause... but whatever is waiting for us down there...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_002.source_new: I have faced many great enemies throughout my life, Zuluhed. Ogres, Arakkoa, and once even a Genesaur... none gave me pause... but whatever is waiting for us down there...

ToD_A04_M13_VO_003.source_old: There is no shame in fearing the unnatural, Rend. Steel yourself by remembering that we will face the horrors of this place together... whatever happens, you will not stand alone.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_003.source_new: There is no shame in fearing the unnatural, Rend. Steel yourself by remembering that we will face the horrors of this place together... whatever happens, you will not stand alone.

ToD_A04_M13_VO_004.source_old: Hmmm... These are orcish runes. No doubt Gul'dan means to use them to find his way out again.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_004.source_new: Hmmm... These are orcish runes. No doubt Gul'dan means to use them to find his way out again.

ToD_A04_M13_VO_005.source_old: Interesting…he describes his arrival to the tomb...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_005.source_new: Interesting... he describes his arrival to the tomb...

ToD_A04_M13_VO_006.source_old: “sigh” There is no telling what kind of power Gul'dan and his minions have awakened in this place. We should be careful.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_006.source_new: There is no telling what kind of power Gul'dan and his minions have awakened in this place. We should be careful.

ToD_A04_M13_VO_007.source_old: Agreed, few things can make orcs scream like that... this... this is wrong...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_007.source_new: Agreed, few things can make orcs scream like that... this... this is wrong...

ToD_A04_M13_VO_008.source_old: Enough talk! The honorless scum must pay for this!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_008.source_new: Enough talk! The honorless scum must pay for this!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_009.source_old: This is a fragment of a staff, it radiates magical power... I will take it.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_009.source_new: This is a fragment of a staff, it radiates magical power... I will take it.

ToD_A04_M13_VO_010.source_old: Finally! The last piece of the Staff! The guardian's Artifact will serve us well.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_010.source_new: Finally! The last piece of the Staff! The guardian's Artifact will serve us well.

ToD_A04_M13_VO_011.source_old: Brothers! The Servants of the Nether have returned!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_011.source_new: Brothers! The Servants of the Nether have returned!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_012.source_old: Stand down, crazed dog! We are not Demons!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_012.source_new: Stand down, crazed dog! We are not Demons!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_013.source_old: Demon spawn! Your crusade will fail against the all-consuming void!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_013.source_new: Demon spawn! Your crusade will fail against the all-consuming void!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_014.source_old: Ugh! I hate spiders, kill 'em fast!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_014.source_new: Ugh! I hate spiders, kill 'em fast!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_015.source_old: Those must be the spirits of the people who once inhabited these lands... they do indeed appear to be elves, fascinating! Be watchful... these restless spirits are vengeful.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_015.source_new: Those must be the spirits of the people who once inhabited these lands... they do indeed appear to be elves, fascinating! Be watchful... these restless spirits are vengeful.

ToD_A04_M13_VO_016.source_old: Ah, look brother, more spiders to fight!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_016.source_new: Ah, look brother, more spiders to fight!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_018.source_old: Ah... I gift fit for a queen.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_018.source_new: Ah... I gift fit for a queen.

ToD_A04_M13_VO_019.source_old: Wha..what is this thing!? Kill it! Kill it fast!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_019.source_new: Wha..what is this thing!? Kill it! Kill it fast!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_020.source_old: Come, my children! Feast on their bones!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_020.source_new: Come, my children! Feast on their bones!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_021.source_old: Hgnh... my prize... it grows heavy..
ToD_A04_M13_VO_021.source_new: Hgnh... my prize... it grows heavy..

ToD_A04_M13_VO_022.source_old: That was a tough fight... Maim? Are you alright big guy?
ToD_A04_M13_VO_022.source_new: That was a tough fight... Maim? Are you alright big guy?

ToD_A04_M13_VO_024.source_old: Poor mangy dogs... this is what happens when you follow a crazed power-hungry warlock...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_024.source_new: Poor mangy dogs... this is what happens when you follow a crazed power-hungry warlock...

ToD_A04_M13_VO_025.source_old: More runes... these should help us find him!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_025.source_new: More runes... these should help us find him!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_026.source_old: Again he mentioned this mysterious eye. What could it be?
ToD_A04_M13_VO_026.source_new: Again he mentioned this mysterious eye. What could it be?

ToD_A04_M13_VO_027.source_old: A powerful artifact... there is no doubt about that. It could be related to the fallen Titan’s power.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_027.source_new: A powerful artifact... there is no doubt about that. It could be related to the fallen Titan’s power.

ToD_A04_M13_VO_028.source_old: Servants of the Warlock, kill them all!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_028.source_new: Servants of the Warlock, kill them all!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_029.source_old: Oi, you there! If you share with us the treasures you found here, we'll fight for you!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_029.source_new: Oi, you there! If you share with us the treasures you found here, we'll fight for you!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_030.source_old: Aah the Seadogs, ever the opportunists! Very well, we can use reinforcements.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_030.source_new: Aah the Seadogs, ever the opportunists! Very well, we can use reinforcements.

ToD_A04_M13_VO_031.source_old: Ah... a vision... a powerful guardian of this world... she defeated the fallen Titan...  split her staff when she locked the tomb!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_031.source_new: Ah... a vision... a powerful guardian of this world... she defeated the fallen Titan...  split her staff when she locked the tomb!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_032.source_old: Turn back, you mortals! None may defile Tomb of Sargeras!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_032.source_new: Turn back, you mortals! None may defile Tomb of Sargeras!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_033.source_old: I can hear a voice beyond the gate... It's Gul'dan!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_033.source_new: I can hear a voice beyond the gate... It's Gul'dan!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_034.source_old: Finally! At long last! I will claim my just reward!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_034.source_new: Finally! At long last! I will claim my just reward!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_036.source_old: Who’s that?! Sargeras? is that you?!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_036.source_new: Who’s that?! Sargeras? Is that you?!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_037.source_old: Did Kil’jaeden's betrayal teach you nothing, little orc?
ToD_A04_M13_VO_037.source_new: Did Kil’jaeden's betrayal teach you nothing, little orc?

ToD_A04_M13_VO_038.source_old: You?! But I watched you die!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_038.source_new: You?! But I watched you die!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_039.source_old: Not that it matters... feel free to witness the moment of my greatest triumph, little magi, but stand in my way... and I will gladly return you to the jaws of death!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_039.source_new: Not that it matters... feel free to witness the moment of my greatest triumph, little magi, but stand in my way... and I will gladly return you to the jaws of death!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_040.source_old: Oh, foolish, pitiful creature... there is so much you do not know, so much you do not understand.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_040.source_new: Oh, foolish, pitiful creature... there is so much you do not know, so much you do not understand.

ToD_A04_M13_VO_041.source_old: Pitiful!? I will show you the meaning of...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_041.source_new: Pitiful!? I will show you the meaning of...

ToD_A04_M13_VO_042.source_old: Treasonous filth! You have never been loyal to anyone but yourself. Your arrogance has blinded you, and has left yourself weak against those who truly tower above you!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_042.source_new: Treasonous filth! You have never been loyal to anyone but yourself. Your arrogance has blinded you, and has left yourself weak against those who truly tower above you!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_044.source_old: Have you forgotten who you were, Gul’dan? Frail, weak and the dog of your clan. I have not forgotten, little Warlock, because it is all that you have ever been… weak!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_044.source_new: Have you forgotten who you were, Gul’dan? Frail, weak and the dog of your clan. I have not forgotten, little Warlock, because it is all that you have ever been... weak!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_046.source_old: You delivered your people to the demons... only to end up humbled and humiliated!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_046.source_new: You delivered your people to the demons... only to end up humbled and humiliated!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_047.source_old: In centuries past, I destroyed this foul avatar and sealed it in this tomb to be forgotten by history... no being of this world could ever open it. Yet my victory was not complete...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_047.source_new: In centuries past, I destroyed this foul avatar and sealed it in this eternal tomb to be forgotten by history... no being of this world could ever open it. Yet my victory was not complete...

ToD_A04_M13_VO_048.source_old: For when I felled him, his foul essence seeped into my soul... an unholy parasite gnawing ever so slowly, until he corrupted my womb and my child...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_048.source_new: For when I felled him, his foul essence seeped into my soul... an unholy parasite gnawing ever so slowly, until he corrupted my womb and my child...

ToD_A04_M13_VO_050.source_old: We often wondered what became of Kil’jaeden’s little puppets... of Mannoroth’s favorite pets... and there you were, broken, confused and so pathetically desperate...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_050.source_new: We often wondered what became of Kil’jaeden’s little puppets... of Mannoroth’s favorite pets... and there you were, broken, confused and so pathetically desperate...

ToD_A04_M13_VO_051.source_old: I... I am... your humble servant, mighty Sargeras! Yes, I am here to break your chains... an agent not of this world... all shall know your glory! And together we will...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_051.source_new: I... I am... your humble servant, mighty Sargeras! Yes, I am here to break your chains... an agent not of this world... all shall know your glory! And together we will...

ToD_A04_M13_VO_052.source_old: Insolent worm! You dare swear fealty in the hour of your greatest failure?! I was freed the moment you entered this tomb, weakling, gaze now upon the might of doom unchained!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_052.source_new: Insolent worm! You dare swear fealty in the hour of your greatest failure?! I was freed the moment you entered this tomb, weakling, gaze now upon the might of doom unchained!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_053.source_old: But Master! I beg of you! I have done all that you’ve asked!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_053.source_new: But Master! I beg of you! I have done all that you’ve asked!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_054.source_old: So spineless… so puny! Fuel to the flame you once controlled! May your cindered husk become a boon… to correct the course that you derailed!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_054.source_new: So spineless... so puny! Fuel to the flame you once controlled! May your cindered husk become a boon... to correct the course that you derailed!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_055.source_old: No! I am Gul'dan! I am darkness incarnate... It cannot end... like this...
ToD_A04_M13_VO_055.source_new: No! I am Gul'dan! I am darkness incarnate... It cannot end... like this...

ToD_A04_M13_VO_056.source_old: The Warlock has been torn to shreds! And whoever killed him has caught the attention of every demon in this place! They’re coming!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_056.source_new: The Warlock has been torn to shreds! And whoever killed him has caught the attention of every demon in this place! They’re coming!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_057.source_old: Our work here is finished! We must get out of here brother!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_057.source_new: Our work here is finished! We must get out of here brother!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_058.source_old: Hold on! The Warchief commanded us to bring him Gul’dan’s head, otherwise he will not believe us!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_058.source_new: Hold on! The Warchief commanded us to bring him Gul’dan’s head, otherwise he will not believe us!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_059.source_old: Feel free Zuluhed… grab it and let’s go!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_059.source_new: Feel free Zuluhed… grab it and let’s go!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_060.source_old: Dammit! Zuluhed! We can’t reach you! But I see a tunnel that might lead to the exit!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_060.source_new: Dammit! Zuluhed! We can’t reach you! But I see a tunnel that might lead to the exit!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_061.source_old: Go with the Wind, Rend. I will find my own way to the surface!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_061.source_new: Go with the Wind, Rend. I will find my own way to the surface!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_062.source_old: Very well…Zuluhed. Aka’magosh! See you on the surface!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_062.source_new: Very well... Zuluhed. Aka’magosh! See you on the surface!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_063.source_old: I am no match for these crazed demons! I must make my way to the surface at once.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_063.source_new: I am no match for these crazed demons! I must make my way to the surface at once!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_064.source_old: That was close, I think they lost my trail.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_064.source_new: That was close, I think they lost my trail.

ToD_A04_M13_VO_066.source_old: Rakmar? Rakmar Sharpfang? I almost didn’t recognize you!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_066.source_new: Rakmar? Rakmar Sharpfang? I almost didn’t recognize you!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_067.source_old: I’m born anew, shaman! I now have more power than you could ever imagine. Praise be to Gul’dan’s gift!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_067.source_new: I’m born anew, shaman! I now have more power than you could ever imagine. Praise be to Gul’dan’s gift!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_068.source_old: Your master is no more, Death Knight! He was slaughtered by the very powers he had sworn to serve… I have his head right here!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_068.source_new: Your master is no more, Death Knight! He was slaughtered by the very powers he had sworn to serve... I have his head right here!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_069.source_old: Such is the price of power! I will lead whatever’s left of the Stormreavers and find new glory!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_069.source_new: Such is the price of power! I will lead whatever’s left of the Stormreavers and find new glory!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_070.source_old: Your allegiance belongs to the Horde. Submit to it or die where you stand!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_070.source_new: Your allegiance belongs to the Horde. Submit to it or die where you stand!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_071.source_old: My allegiance is my own, Shaman! Come then… show me what you’ve got!
ToD_A04_M13_VO_071.source_new: My allegiance is my own, Shaman! Come then... show me what you’ve got!

ToD_A04_M13_VO_073.source_old: May this place crumble and return to the seas... forever.
ToD_A04_M13_VO_073.source_new: May this place crumble and return to the seas... forever.

ToD_A04_M13_TXT_003.source_old: Gul'dan's nefarious plans have led him deep into the Tomb of Sargeras. You must find the Traitor and discover what he's up to.
ToD_A04_M13_TXT_003.source_new: Gul'dan's nefarious plans have led him deep into the Tomb of Sargeras. You must find the Traitor and discover what he's up to.
